_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: krea2-Turbo GGUF primary model for mouth viseme inpainting. Matches image_krea2.json node 1.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: Qwen3-VL-4B fp8_scaled text encoder for krea2.

_meta.title: REF_IMAGE
_meta.note: Character face close-up reference frame. Patched per character.

_meta.title: MASK_IMAGE
_meta.note: Mouth region mask (white = inpaint area). Patched per viseme.

_meta.title: INPAINT_ENCODE
_meta.note: Encodes reference image + mask into krea2 16-channel latent space via qwen_image_vae.

_meta.title: VISEME_PROMPT
_meta.note: Positive prompt describing the mouth shape. Patched per viseme (A/E/I/O/U/M/F/L/REST).

inputs.text: same character, close-up on mouth area only. Mouth shape: slightly open, lips relaxed. Face is exactly the same as the reference image, no changes to eyes, hair, or other features. anime art style, masterpiece, best quality.

_meta.title: PROMPT_NEG
_meta.note: Negative prompt to preserve the character's face identity during inpainting.

inputs.text: different face, changed eyes, changed hair, different character, extra mouth, extra lips, missing mouth, deformed face, lowres, blurry

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: krea2 inpainting recipe: euler/simple, 8 steps, cfg 1.0, denoise 0.65 — lower denoise preserves face, higher blends mouth better. SEED patched from hash(character_id, viseme_id).

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: Decodes the inpainted latent back to RGB via qwen_image_vae.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the viseme PNG. ComfyClient copies it out and renames to viseme_{A,E,I,O,U,M,F,L,REST}.png.
